remarks: Welcome to Parkhaven! This affordable 2-storey townhouse in the community of Rundle Heights is an excellent opportunity for first-time buyers, investors, or anyone looking to get into the Edmonton real estate market. Offering 3 bedrooms, 1.5 bathrooms and over 1,033 sq. ft. of living space, this home features a functional layout with plenty of room for comfortable everyday living. The main floor offers a spacious living room filled with natural light, a functional kitchen with updated countertops, and a dining area. Upstairs, you'll find three generously sized bedrooms, including an oversized primary bedroom, along with a full bathroom. Enjoy the convenience of a patio and an assigned parking stall. The location is hard to beat, with shopping, schools, parks, playgrounds, public transportation, skating rinks, golf, and the Rundle Park Recreation Centre all nearby. Whether you're looking for an affordable place to call home or a property with investment potential, this is an opportunity worth exploring. (id:67522)
